display.label: Load Balancer
display.description: Azure Load Balancer (Layer 4) delivering high availability and network performance for applications

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Load Balancer. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Load Balancer identity and location settings.

fields.label: Load Balancer Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure Load Balancer. Must be between 1 and 80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

validation.pattern_error: Load Balancer name must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Load Balancer.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Load Balancer should be created.

sections.label: Load Balancer Sizing & Tier
sections.description: SKU, routing tier, and deployment type (Public vs Internal).

fields.label: SKU
fields.description: The SKU of the Azure Load Balancer. Standard is recommended for production enterprise workloads.

fields.label: SKU Tier
fields.description: The SKU tier of the Load Balancer. Regional operates within a single region; Global provides cross-region balancing (Standard SKU only).

fields.label: Load Balancer Type
fields.description: Public (internet-facing via Public IP) or Internal (private multi-tier VNet traffic via Subnet).

sections.label: Frontend IP Configuration
sections.description: Frontend IP configurations for the Load Balancer. At least one is required.

fields.label: Frontend Configurations
fields.description: List of frontend IP configurations.

fields.label: Configuration Name
fields.description: The unique name of the frontend IP configuration.

fields.label: Public IP Address ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the Public IP address (for Public Load Balancer).

fields.label: Public IP Prefix ID
fields.description: Resource ID of a Public IP Prefix (for Public Load Balancer).

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the Subnet (for Internal Load Balancer).

fields.label: Private IP Address
fields.description: Static private IP address within the subnet (optional for Internal Load Balancer).

fields.label: Private IP Allocation
fields.description: Allocation method for private IP address: Dynamic or Static.

fields.label: Private IP Version
fields.description: The IP version for the private IP address.

fields.label: Availability Zones
fields.description: List of availability zones (e.g. ['1', '2', '3']).

sections.label: Backend Address Pools
sections.description: Backend address pools for target virtual machines or NICs.

fields.label: Backend Pools
fields.description: List of backend address pools to create for this Load Balancer.

fields.label: Pool Name
fields.description: The name of the backend address pool.

fields.label: Virtual Network ID
fields.description: Virtual Network ID (optional, required if using IP-based backend pool addresses).

sections.label: Health Probes
sections.description: Health probes to monitor backend application status.

fields.label: Health Probes
fields.description: List of health probes to create for this Load Balancer.

fields.label: Probe Name
fields.description: The name of the health probe.

fields.label: Probe Port
fields.description: Port on which the probe checks health (1-65535).

fields.label: Protocol
fields.description: Protocol used by the health probe: Tcp, Http, or Https.

fields.label: Request Path
fields.description: URI used for checking health status (required if protocol is Http or Https).

fields.label: Interval (seconds)
fields.description: Interval between health probes in seconds. Default: 15.

fields.label: Unhealthy Threshold
fields.description: The number of consecutive probe failures required before considering an instance unhealthy. Default: 2.

sections.label: Load Balancing Rules
sections.description: Rules defining how inbound traffic on a frontend port is distributed to backend instances.

fields.label: Load Balancing Rules
fields.description: List of load balancing rules.

fields.label: Rule Name
fields.description: The name of the load balancing rule.

fields.label: Frontend IP Configuration Name
fields.description: The name of the frontend IP configuration to which this rule applies.

fields.label: Frontend Port
fields.description: The port for inbound traffic exposed by the load balancer.

fields.label: Backend Port
fields.description: The port on backend targets to which traffic is routed.

fields.label: Protocol
fields.description: The transport protocol: Tcp, Udp, or All.

fields.label: Backend Pool Name
fields.description: Name of the backend pool defined in this module to bind to this rule.

fields.label: Health Probe Name
fields.description: Name of the health probe defined in this module to monitor backend instances.

fields.label: Enable Floating IP (Direct Server Return)
fields.description: Enable Floating IP / Direct Server Return (required for SQL AlwaysOn availability groups).

fields.label: TCP Idle Timeout (minutes)
fields.description: Idle timeout in minutes for TCP connections (4 to 30). Default: 4.

fields.label: Load Distribution
fields.description: Session persistence method: Default (5-tuple), SourceIP (2-tuple), or SourceIPProtocol (3-tuple).

sections.label: Inbound NAT Rules
sections.description: Direct port forwarding rules mapping a frontend port to a specific backend port.

fields.label: Inbound NAT Rules
fields.description: List of inbound NAT rules.

fields.label: NAT Rule Name
fields.description: The name of the inbound NAT rule.

fields.label: Frontend IP Configuration Name
fields.description: The name of the frontend IP configuration to receive traffic.

fields.label: Frontend Port
fields.description: External frontend port (e.g. 2221).

fields.label: Backend Port
fields.description: Target backend port (e.g. 22 for SSH, 3389 for RDP).

fields.label: Protocol
fields.description: Transport protocol: Tcp or Udp.

fields.label: Idle Timeout (minutes)
fields.description: TCP idle timeout in minutes (4 to 30). Default: 4.

fields.label: Enable Floating IP
fields.description: Enable Direct Server Return.

fields.label: Edge Zone
fields.description: The Edge Zone within the Azure Region where this Load Balancer should exist.

sections.label: Resource Tags
sections.description: Key-value pairs to categorize this Load Balancer.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Tags assigned to the Load Balancer.
